channel.title: Clearbid Proposal Services blog
channel.description: Practical guides for small contractors on bids, proposals and government contracting.

item.title: What to Put on a Capability Statement (With a Sample)
item.description: What belongs on a one-page capability statement, section by section, shown with a sample we wrote for a fictional janitorial company and tips from agency guides.

item.title: What a Compliance Matrix Is and How to Build One for Any RFP
item.description: What a compliance matrix is, where requirements hide in federal and Mississippi bids, and how to build one step by step and use it to check your bid before you submit.

item.title: Why Bids Get Rejected and How to Avoid the Most Common Mistakes
item.description: Late bids, missed amendments, bid bond errors, missing signatures, SAM and licensing gaps, page limits: why bids get thrown out under federal and Mississippi rules.

item.title: How to Find and Bid on Government Contracts in Mississippi
item.description: Where federal, state and local bids in Mississippi are posted, how to register for each, and the dollar thresholds that decide whether a job is advertised at all.
